verdict.rationale: No native bulk-action feature is documented. The closest evidence is the Signals Migrator, which imports PagerDuty or Opsgenie configuration in one pass, and the API, which covers 'anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI'. Together these suggest bulk changes are only possible as a one-time migration or by scripting the API yourself. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit, close or update actions across many incidents, alerts, or entities; batch API endpoints; any hands-on or independent evidence of bulk workflows.
